title: The Stochastic Deputy: Structural Tenant Isolation for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.14780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-tenant tools commonly accept a tenant identifier and validate it against the caller's entitlement. For a large language model (LLM) agent, that pattern delegates resource selection to a process whose context may contain attacker controlled instructions. We formalize this stochastic deputy problem and present a structural defense: remove tenant identity from the Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema, bind scope to a verified credential, and enforce it below the agent. In a 373-trial ablation across eight model configurations and two transports, a correctly validated tenant parameter served every out-of-scope attempt: 26 of 26, or 26 of 41 plausible-pretext trials overall. With the parameter removed, no tool signature could express the read. translated_title: 随机代理人：面向工具使用型大语言模型智能体的结构化租户隔离
translated_abstract: 多租户工具通常接受一个租户标识符，并根据调用者的权限对其进行验证。对于大语言模型（LLM）智能体而言，这种模式将资源选择委托给一个其上下文可能包含攻击者可控指令的进程。我们形式化了这一“随机代理人”问题，并提出了一种结构性防御方案：从模型上下文协议（MCP）工具模式中移除租户身份，将作用域绑定到经验证的凭证，并在智能体之下强制执行。在一项涵盖八种模型配置和两种传输方式的373次试验消融研究中，经过正确验证的租户参数满足了所有越权访问尝试：总体上为26次中的26次，或在合理借口场景下为41次中的26次。移除该参数后，任何工具签名都无法表达此类读取操作。56次试验中有12次转而通过伪造可写作用域来绕过接口，这表明接口不变性需要密码学保护的上下文。在一个包含…
tldr: 该论文形式化了LLM智能体的“随机代理人”安全问题，证明通过工具参数验证租户身份无法抵御上下文注入攻击，并提出将租户身份从MCP工具模式中移除、绑定加密验证凭证并在智能体之下强制执行的结构化租户隔离防御方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the "stochastic deputy problem" where LLM agents relying on parameter-validated tenant IDs remain vulnerable to context injection, and proposes structural tenant isolation by removing tenant identity from MCP tool schemas and binding scope to cryptographically verified credentials enforced below the agent.
